name: design-schema
description: Documentation-first, schema-driven, cross-platform design system generator.

scripts.check: node --import tsx tools/theme.ts && node tokens/build.mjs && node --import tsx tools/schema.ts --check && node --import tsx tools/parse.ts && node --import tsx tools/check_contrast.ts && node --import tsx tools/spec_sheet.ts
scripts.build: pnpm check && pnpm tokens && pnpm lint:literals && pnpm generate:check && pnpm --filter site build
scripts.gates: node --import tsx tools/checks.ts --platform web && node --import tsx tools/checks.ts --platform lit && node --import tsx tools/checks.ts --platform rn
scripts.gates:behavior: node --import tsx tools/behavior_tests.ts && pnpm --filter @design-schema/react run test generated/behavior && pnpm --filter @design-schema/lit run test generated/behavior && pnpm --filter @design-schema/rn run test generated/behavior
scripts.release:check: pnpm build:packages && pnpm -r --filter "@design-schema/*" exec publint && pnpm -r --filter "@design-schema/*" exec attw --pack && pnpm -r --filter "@design-schema/*" exec npm pack --dry-run
